selva.definition: n a rain forest in a tropical area
selva.translation: n. (尤指南美洲亚马孙河沿岸的)热带雨林

selvage.definition:
n. border consisting of an ornamental fringe at either end of an oriental carpet
n. the edge of a fabric that is woven so that it will not ravel or fray

selvagee.definition:
n. A skein or hank of rope yarns wound round with yarns or
   marline, -- used for stoppers, straps, etc.

selvagen.translation: abbr. Selvagen Islands between the Canaries and Madeira 加那利群岛和马德拉群岛之间的萨尔瓦根岛

selvagens.translation: (selvagen 的复数) abbr. Selvagen Islands between the Canaries and Madeira 加那利群岛和马德拉群岛之间的萨尔瓦根岛

selvas.definition: n. pl. Vast woodland plains of South America.
selvas.translation: [地名] [巴西] 塞尔瓦斯林原

selvedge.definition:
n border consisting of an ornamental fringe at either end of an oriental carpet
n the edge of a fabric that is woven so that it will not ravel or fray

selvedged.translation: n. 布边, 织边；(织物、纸等的)切边, 余边

selvedges.definition:
plural of selvedge
n border consisting of an ornamental fringe at either end of an oriental carpet
n the edge of a fabric that is woven so that it will not ravel or fray
selvedges.translation: (selvedge 的复数) n. 织边, 镶边

selves.definition:
n your consciousness of your own identity
n a person considered as a unique individual
selves.translation: 自己, 自我, 本性, 本质, 私心, 本人
